title: Lake Roosevelt National Recreation Area: Hawk Creek Area Closed for 2026 Recreation Season
summary: The Hawk Creek Campground and boat launch area will close to all public access starting April 16 through November 14. The closure is necessary to keep visitors, staff, and construction crews safe during the Hawk Creek Road Improvements and Stabilization Project. It may be extended to next spring, if needed.

title: Lake Roosevelt National Recreation Area
summary: The ancient geologic landscape of the upper Columbia River cradles Lake Roosevelt in walls of stone carved by massive ice age floods. Come explore the shorelines and learn the stories of American Indians, traders and trappers, settlers and dam builders who called this place home. Swim, boat, hike, camp, and fish at this hidden gem in Northeast Washington, created by the Grand Coulee Dam.
